description: Source code for HomeFragment.kt, an Android Fragment implementing the main home screen UI for a streaming app. It manages a top navigation bar and multiple content rows with mock data, supporting D-pad navigation, focus handling, and styled text.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main UI Fragment for the home screen, managing layout, focus, and content setup.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Data model representing a content card with id, title, and image URL.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Model representing a row of content titles and items.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up brand styling, top navigation, and content rails after view creation.

methods.name: setupBrand
methods.description: Initializes the brand TextView with styled text and accessibility label.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Configures the horizontal scrolling top navigation bar with categories and search icon.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Creates mock content rows and sets up associated RecyclerView adapters.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears view binding reference to prevent memory leaks.
